verdict.rationale: Belvo's API spec lists an Enrichment API with Incomes, Recurring Expenses, Risk Insights and Employment Metrics endpoints (belvo-docs-15). These derive income and recurring cash-flow signals from connected-account data. Belvo also documents a Brazil employment and income verification product exposing historical and current salary per employer (belvo-docs-2, belvo-docs-23). missing for 10: detailed documentation of how income streams and payroll are detected (methodology, fields, coverage by country), explicit payroll-detection wording, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the enrichment outputs.
